headlines.title: TotalEnergies takes 25% of 26 Chevron-run offshore U.S. exploration leases
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Energy company TotalEnergies has acquired a 25% working interest in 26 exploration leases operated by Chevron offshore the United States.

headlines.title: United States: TotalEnergies Enters 26 Chevron-Operated Offshore Exploration Blocks, Strengthening the Successful U.S. Partnership Between Both Companies
headlines.summary: PARIS, October 28, 2026--TotalEnergies (Paris:TTE) (LSE:TTE) (NYSE:TTE) announces the acquisition of a 25% working interest in 26 Chevron-operated exploration leases offshore the United States. As part of the transaction, Chevron also acquires from TotalEnergies a 75% operated interest in two exploration leases adjacent to existing jointly held exploration leases.

headlines.title: Chevron (CVX) Eyes Vaca Muerta Growth As The Valuation Debate Tightens
headlines.summary: Chevron (CVX) is back in focus after outlining a proposed US$13.8b investment program in Argentina’s Vaca Muerta shale through 2035, targeting a tripling of oil production from its current regional output. Chevron’s proposed Vaca Muerta outlay lands at a time when momentum in the stock has clearly picked up, with a 30 day share price return of 13.48% feeding into a 48.82% year to date move and a 55.30% total shareholder return over the past year.

description: Chevron Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the integrated energy and chemicals operations. It operates through Upstream and Downstream segments. The Upstream segment engages in the exploration for, development, production, and transportation of crude oil and natural gas; processing, liquefaction, transportation, and regasification of liquefied natural gas; transportation of crude oil through pipelines; transportation, storage, and marketing of natural gas; carbon capture and storage; and operation of a gas-to-liquids plant. The Downstream segment refines crude oil into petroleum products; markets crude oil, refined products, and lubricants; manufactures and markets renewable fuels; transports crude oil and refined products through pipeline, marine vessel, motor equipment, and rail car; and manufactures and markets commodity petrochemicals, plastics for industrial uses, and fuel and lubricant additives. The company operates in North America, South America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. The company was formerly known as ChevronTexaco Corporation and changed its name to Chevron Corporation in May 2005. Chevron Corporation was founded in 1879 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
